continuous_maps.use: Reserved landscape/heatmap alternative, declared per approved figure

semantic_rules: All statistical baselines share B; distinguish them using fixed markers, dashes and direct labels.
C is reserved for classical optimisation solvers, not statistical regression baselines.
P denotes observed development near-positives V<=2, never confirmed hidden V=0 or merely predicted positives.
Pass/fail uses text or symbols, not a reuse of the nonmetal colour.
Methods keep method colour; sample-class decompositions keep metal/nonmetal colour.
Light baseline/metal glyphs require dark outlines; semantic text uses neutral dark ink.
At most five semantic hues per formal panel; the palette proof is an eight-role diagnostic exception.
No formal figure or inventory is generated before the relevant user approval.
